_comment: Prompts de la pipeline food-photo. 'style' et 'negative' sont communs ; chaque entrée ne decrit que le sujet.
recipeStyle: professional food photography, {subject}, served on a rustic ceramic plate, dark walnut table, natural window light from the left, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, appetizing, fresh herbs garnish, styled by a food stylist, editorial cookbook shot, high detail, photorealistic
foodStyle: product photography of {subject}, single ingredient, centered on a white marble surface with generous empty space around it, the whole subject visible and not cropped, soft diffused daylight, top-down flat lay, clean minimal composition, no packaging, no label, high detail, photorealistic
negative: text, letters, watermark, logo, brand, packaging, label, hands, fingers, people, person, face, cutlery in mouth, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, plastic looking, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, deformed, duplicate, cluttered background, messy
